➕ Add Paper / Walk-In Student

📤 Upload Existing Roster

Upload XLSX/XLS/CSV. The site looks for names, DOB, agency, SAC ID, and POST ID. Exact IDs or Name + DOB are used to suppress duplicates.

🕒 Daily Attendance Operations

The daily QR is registered with the backend and expires after 20 minutes. Yesterday's QR will not validate today. A same-day screenshot can still be shared, so this remains an attendance control—not biometric proof.

Upload Scanned Paper Attendance (CV-ready)

Stores the scan with the section/date. The companion Apps Script includes an optional computer-vision webhook hook; until a vision service is configured, the TA can use the daily review screen to digitize the paper record.
